title: 5-Bedroom Fully Detached Duplex with BQ
description:
A contemporary fully detached duplex on a quiet street in Benin City's GRA. The ground floor opens into a double-volume living room, a separate family lounge, a guest bedroom en suite and a fitted kitchen with a walk-in pantry.

Upstairs, four bedrooms each have their own bathroom, with the principal suite offering a dressing room and private balcony. A two-room boys' quarters, generous parking and a gatehouse complete the compound.

title: 3-Bedroom Serviced Apartment
description:
A well-finished serviced apartment in a compact block of six units, a short drive from the Sapele Road corridor. All three bedrooms are en suite, and the open-plan living and dining area connects to a fitted kitchen and a small balcony.

Service charge covers shared power backup, water, security and cleaning of common areas.

title: Full Plot of Dry Land in a Gated Estate
paymentPlan: Outright payment or instalments over 6 months (to be confirmed per buyer)
description:
A full plot of dry, level land inside a gated residential estate off Airport Road. The estate has a perimeter fence, a controlled entrance and an internal road network.

Suitable for a family home or a small block of flats. Documentation details are shared on enquiry and should be verified independently before payment.

title: 4-Bedroom Terrace Duplex
description:
One of four newly completed terrace duplexes in a small, secure development off Ekenwan Road. Each unit has its own entrance, parking space and small rear garden.

The layout includes a living room with guest toilet, a kitchen with store, three en suite bedrooms upstairs and a ground-floor fourth bedroom suitable for guests or a home office.

title: Ground-Floor Commercial Space
description:
A bright, open-plan ground-floor space with strong street frontage on a busy commercial corridor. Suitable for retail, a showroom, a bank branch or a professional office.

The unit has two toilets, a small back office and shared parking at the front of the building.

title: 2-Bedroom Luxury Shortlet Apartment
description:
A fully furnished two-bedroom apartment for short stays in GRA — well placed for visitors, business travellers and families home for the holidays.

The apartment comes with fast Wi-Fi, smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen and constant power. Availability and minimum stay are confirmed on enquiry.

title: Off-Plan 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Duplexes
paymentPlan: Initial deposit, then staged payments over 12 months during construction (indicative — confirm current terms with Pablo Homes)
description:
A planned development of semi-detached duplexes in Okha, offered off-plan. Each home is designed with four en suite bedrooms, a living and dining area, a family lounge upstairs and a one-room BQ.

Off-plan purchases carry construction and timeline risk. Ask for the approved plans, title documents and the developer's delivery schedule, and review them with your own lawyer before committing.

title: Half Plot for Residential Development
description:
A half plot in a developing residential neighbourhood along Upper Sokponba, with occupied homes nearby and access from a motorable road.

A practical starting point for a first family home or a bungalow. Full documentation is available for review on request.

title: 2-Bedroom Apartment in a Quiet Close
description:
A tidy two-bedroom apartment on the first floor of a four-unit building in a quiet close in Uselu, with a kitchen, a living room and a guest toilet.

This apartment has been rented. Contact Pablo Homes to hear about similar apartments in the area.

title: 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Duplex
description:
A semi-detached duplex close to the university axis in Ugbowo, with a spacious living area, four en suite bedrooms and a covered car port.

This property has been sold. Speak to Pablo Homes about comparable homes currently available.

title: Two-Storey Office Building
description:
A standalone two-storey office building on two plots with road frontage, open-plan floors, meeting rooms and ample on-site parking.

Suitable for an owner-occupier or for letting floor by floor. Buyers should commission their own valuation and structural survey.

title: Two Plots of Commercial Land
description:
Two adjoining plots with frontage on an access road in Ugbor, suited to a commercial or mixed-use development.

The land is fenced on two sides. Survey and title documents are available for inspection on request.
